basic_details.job_title: Family Court Pratapgarh Counselor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Family Court Pratapgarh has notified 1 vacancy for the Counselor post on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply offline by sending their application by registered post or submitting it in person on working days to the office of Principal Judge, Family Court, Pratapgarh on or before 27 October 2026. Applicants must be a resident of Pratapgarh district, and individuals who are a party in any case pending in any Family Court are ineligible to apply. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their completed application form along with self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates to the following postal address by registered post or deliver it in person on working days: Office of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Graduation degree in Sociology or Psychology with experience in social service. Preference is given to candidates with a Master's degree in Social Work and 2 years of experience in family matters (counseling). Residency Requirement: The applicant must be a resident of Pratapgarh district. Disqualification: Individuals who are a party in any case pending in any Family Court are ineligible to apply. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Family Court Pratapgarh Counselor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Counselor post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Family Court Pratapgarh Counselor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Graduation degree in Sociology or Psychology along with experience in social service. A Master's degree in Social Work with 2 years of experience in family counseling is given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The candidate's age must be between 35 years and 65 years as of the date of issuance of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending them through registered post or by delivering them in person on working days to the office of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Pratapgarh.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply based on residency?
faq.answer: Applicants must be residents of Pratapgarh district.

faq.question: Q8. Can anyone with a pending family court case apply?
faq.answer: No, individuals who are a party in any case pending in any Family Court are ineligible to apply.
